scope: Scaled additive QK logit contribution, summing only the 42 selected constant rotary pairs belonging to this axis; all 12 heads reported separately for each layer/step/branch. No token, prompt, step, head or branch averages. Delta is query minus key patch-grid position. Each table contains its own axis contribution; the total bias is the sum of all three axis tables. Initial constants pool all-token pre-RoPE post-RMSNorm means equally over 64 calibration prompts; trained constants come from the final EMA. Layer indices zero-based; denoising steps one-based.
